grid.layout_notes: Official rowsReels 4-5-5-5-4 (22 paylines per page marketing text).

win_system.notes: winType Lines; unusual 4-5-5-5-4 grid with 22 distinct win lines (page copy).

respins.how_it_works: Win Respins: winning symbols (and all instances of those types), Wilds, Bonus (base only), and Revolvers stick; new sticky awards +1 respin. Payout when no respins left. xNudge Wilds nudge fully when respins done.

other.name: Revolver bullets
other.how_it_works: Revolvers (3-6 bullets) fire one bullet each per spin left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Bullet types: Wild, xSplit (double target mult), Upgrade (to higher pay), xNudge Wild (reels 2/4), xNudge Multiplier (+2x/3x/10x/100x additive), or Random.

other.name: Unleash / Refill
other.how_it_works: Unleash: all Revolvers fire remaining bullets one after another (max one Unleash per spin). Refill: all Revolvers to 6 bullets (max one Refill per spin).

wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: Can land normally or from Wild bullet.

wilds.name: xNudge Wild
wilds.behavior: From xNudge Wild bullet above top of reels 2/4; nudges fully visible when no respins left; each nudge +1 win mult. Multiplier bullets can raise xNudge mult by 2x/3x/10x/100x (additive).

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: 3 awards 6 Gunslinger Spins (+1 per extra); 4 awards 8 Outlaw Spins; 5 awards 10 Widowmaker Spins.

multipliers.name: xNudge multiplier
multipliers.behavior: Persists across Gunslinger/Outlaw/Widowmaker spins (does not reset). Extra Spin keeps prior xNudge mults.

specials.name: Revolver
specials.behavior: 3-6 bullets; one fire per spin (or all remaining on Unleash / Widowmaker end). Sticky during Win Respins.

specials.name: Unleash / Refill
specials.behavior: Unleash fires all remaining bullets; Refill reloads to 6. One of each max per spin.

base_game_loop.summary: Line spin on 4-5-5-5-4 (22 lines). Wins award Win Respins with sticky winning types/Wild/Bonus/Revolver. Revolvers fire bullets (Wild/xSplit/Upgrade/xNudge/xNudge mult/Random); Unleash/Refill modifiers. 3/4/5 Bonus awards Gunslinger 6 / Outlaw 8 / Widowmaker 10. Boosters 2x/30x/190x/999x; optional Extra Spin after bonus.

phases.name: Configure boosters
phases.what_happens: Optional: Bonus Booster 2x (Bonus reel 2); xNudge Showdown 30x; xNudge Fully Loaded 190x; Revolver Mayhem 999x.

phases.name: Spin + Revolvers
phases.what_happens: Reels stop; Revolvers fire one bullet each (or Unleash/Refill); optional sticky Win Respins until no new stickies.
phases.ends_when: No respins left; then xNudge Wilds nudge fully

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Pay 22 lines with Wild/xNudge mults when respins exhausted.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: 3/4/5 Bonus awards Gunslinger 6 / Outlaw 8 / Widowmaker 10 (+1 spin per extra Bonus on Gunslinger).

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Payout after Win Respins end and xNudge Wilds have nudged; xNudge mults apply.
base_game_loop.notes: From official CMS on nolimitcity.com/games/tombstone-begins. No standard scatter buy price band listed — boosters and Extra Spin only.

modes.name: Gunslinger Spins
modes.trigger: 3 Bonus symbols (+1 spin per additional Bonus).
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: xNudge multiplier does not reset between Gunslinger Spins. Win Respins still apply.
modes.progressive_state: Accumulated xNudge mult persists across the bonus.
modes.end_condition: Spins done or Vengeance 20,000x; optional Extra Spin offer.

phases.name: Enter Gunslinger
phases.what_happens: Award 6 (+extras) spins; keep xNudge mult across spins.

phases.name: Extra Spin offer
phases.what_happens: After bonus, may buy Extra Spin keeping xNudge mults; guaranteed Revolver with xNudge bullet if cost is at most total win.

modes.effects: 6+ FS; persistent xNudge mult; Win Respins + Revolvers.

modes.name: Outlaw Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All Gunslinger features; all Revolvers land fully loaded.
modes.end_condition: Spins done or 20,000x; optional Extra Spin.

phases.name: Enter Outlaw
phases.what_happens: 8 spins; Revolvers fully loaded; persistent xNudge mult.

modes.effects: 8 FS; fully loaded Revolvers; persistent xNudge mult.

modes.name: Widowmaker Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Outlaw features plus: all Revolvers fire remaining bullets before xNudge activation or when no respins left after a respin award. After all Revolvers fired, bullet-formed wins do not award more respins.
modes.end_condition: Spins done or 20,000x; optional Extra Spin.

phases.name: Enter Widowmaker
phases.what_happens: 10 spins; fully loaded and dump remaining bullets at end of respin chain.

modes.effects: 10 FS; fully loaded; dump remaining bullets; no extra respins from post-dump bullet wins.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Extra Spin cost calculated from Nudge multipliers; offered only if cost is at most total win.

features.name: Win Respins
features.effects: Sticky winning types/Wild/Bonus(base)/Revolver; +respin on new sticky; pay when done.

features.name: Revolver / Unleash / Refill
features.effects: Fire bullets; Unleash dumps remaining; Refill to 6.

features.name: xSplit bullet
features.effects: Doubles target symbol multiplier (regulars or Wilds).

features.name: xNudge Showdown
features.effects: Revolver with 2 xNudge + 2 xNudge multiplier bullets.

features.name: xNudge Fully Loaded
features.effects: Revolver with 3 xNudge + 3 xNudge multiplier bullets.

features.name: Revolver Mayhem
features.effects: 6 Revolvers on top/bottom of reels 2-4; 3 with xNudge mult bullets and one xNudge bullet.

features.name: Extra Spin
features.trigger: After bonus if cost at most total win
features.effects: Buy one more spin keeping xNudge mults; guaranteed Revolver with xNudge bullet.

options.name: Revolver Mayhem
options.effects: 6 Revolvers on reels 2-4 extremes with guaranteed xNudge payload.

options.name: Extra Spin
options.effects: Post-bonus extra spin keeping mults; guaranteed xNudge Revolver if offered.

feature_buy.notes: CMS shows Widowmaker Spins (Nolimit Bonus) icon without price text; not invented. No free-spin buy band printed.

ante_bet.notes: No classic xBet ante; Bonus Booster 2x is the light per-spin guarantee.
